statusLine.command: input=$(cat); total=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '(.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0) + (.context_window.total_output_tokens // 0)'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); if [ -n "$used" ]; then printf "Tokens: %s | Context: %.0f%% used" "$total" "$used"; else printf "Tokens: %s" "$total"; fi
